_comment: Update manifest for the Powenetics V2/V3 desktop apps. Served raw over HTTPS from this public repo so the in-app updater can read it anonymously (the app source repos are private). PresentMon is intentionally NOT listed - it comes straight from Intel's public GameTechDev/PresentMon releases API. Every url MUST be https; the app rejects plain HTTP, rejects any download whose sha256 does not match, and additionally requires a valid Authenticode signature for RTSS (MICRO-STAR INTERNATIONAL). Entries below are seeded to the versions currently shipping, so a check reports 'up to date' until you publish something newer.

rtss.notes: RTSS 7.3.5.28314 - the runtime bundled with and vetted against Powenetics.

powenetics-v2.notes: Still UNTESTED: the experimental PMD revive guide has not yet succeeded on a real board; use it entirely at your own responsibility. 22.94 adds log, USB report and Save firmware hex buttons, a re-plug instruction between Step 1 and Step 2, and a more robust connection (stale-frame purge, stricter frame sync).

powenetics-v3.notes: Initial public V3 release. Self-contained Windows x64 app and CLI updater, validated log loading and mainboard streaming. V3 hardware only; electrical accuracy and fan/BNC/PicoScope bench validation remain open.

pcue.notes: Adds the native Linux desktop and unattended updates. Installed Windows copies silently update and restart only with disconnected controllers, no RPM hold/acquisition and completed recovery. Existing shared controller revision 7 and pinned dependencies are unchanged. Unsigned installer; locally validated.

win11perfwidget.notes: RAM Usage and VRAM Usage side by side, with independent percentages and used/total GB. Existing memory tile settings and position are preserved; no optional GPU tile needed. Signed installer hosted publicly because the source is private.

fanrpmcontrol.notes: One update button: the banner checks when nothing is pending and installs (SHA-256 verified, confirmed) when an update is available. Polarity interlock removed, CLI discover + SSE streaming, .NET 10 throughout.

pcue-linux.notes: Ubuntu/Debian x64 native desktop with bundled .NET 10. Debian scheduled updates defer while the GUI runs or recovery is pending; portable updates prepare and verify the runtime before restarting. USB control is experimental and physical Linux commissioning is pending. Be quiet IO, motherboard PWM and local acoustic leases are unavailable.

musedesktop.notes:
Muse Desktop 0.1.9

Send ASAP messages into a running task, with ordinary queued messages preserved.
Use the visible Compact button and see progress summaries while a response is running.
Muse models default to High reasoning where supported, with complete, detailed response preferences.
Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is available through the existing contributor consent control.
Local AI brings configured cluster and Rendering PC models into one category.
Muse startup usage shows its last observation with a timestamp; Codex shows its native quota windows, including weekly-only accounts.
Updated for Muse CLI 1.4.10. CLI updates refresh the host/catalog and check for a desktop update. Sandbox proof is checked again for a new binary.
Context memory and the provider's maximum reply length are labelled separately.
